parser_policy.input: Only greedy.text. No question, gold, case group, candidate scores or agreement across arms.
precedence: Whole output is one integer after whitespace and at most one terminal ASCII/Chinese full stop.
Terminal explicit final-answer marker followed by an integer, or terminal boxed integer.
Last nonempty line is an entire arithmetic equality chain ending in an integer, with no trailing prose.
Otherwise unresolved. Never take an arbitrary last number or evaluate a missing arithmetic answer.
parser_policy.math_grammar: AST arithmetic only; ASCII variable names allowed; no calls, indexing, attributes, evaluation or equation-truth check.
parser_policy.math_normalization: Unicode minus/multiplication/division, superscript digit exponent, ^ to **; original text retained.
parser_policy.denominator: All 16 fixed states per arm; unresolved separate and not dropped.
parser_policy.strict_metric: Frozen original strict_integer and strict_correct copied unchanged.
